planets.name: HD 110082 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 110082 with a 10.2-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: HD 110082 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 110082. Its orbit and size follow Tofflemire et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
